raw_definitions: Definisi : ~ /boy, girl/, ( in sports ), /raja, ratu/ sst: the ~ boys of Malaysian badminton , raja-raja badminton Malaysia. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : adj 1. made of, largely consisting of, gold , emas: a ~ crown , mahkota emas; 2. like gold in colour , (berwarna) keemasan, berwarna emas: ~ hair , rambut keemasan; ~ yellow , kuning keemasan; 3. a. favourable , keemasan: a ~ opportunity , peluang keemasan; b. happy, glorious , sangat bahagia: the ~ days of our lives , hari-hari yg sangat bahagia dlm hidup kita; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
